---
name: Core bug / feature / performance request
about: Report a reusable platform defect or capability needed by a research study
title: "[core] "
---

## Request type and impact

Bug / missing capability / performance / compatibility.

## Requesting research

- Research repository, study ID, exact commit / PR:
- Core repository, exact commit, package version and wheel SHA-256:
- Python / OS / relevant optional extras:
- Is the study blocked? Existing related Issue / PR / Task:

## Expected contract and actual behavior

Describe the reusable contract rather than a strategy's desired profit.

## Minimal reproducer

Prefer a deterministic synthetic fixture and the exact command, error or
incorrect numeric value. Specify timeframe, native-bar vs elapsed-time units,
availability, execution/risk settings and source identity when relevant.

Do not attach credentials, private data, sealed/unused inputs, or confidential
research artifacts. Use authorized redacted receipts or synthetic data.

## Acceptance criteria

- Observable behavior and independent test oracle:
- Affected API / persisted schema / source identity / compatibility:
- Failure, gap, time-boundary, numerical and resource-limit cases:
- Required docs, test, CI and release checks:

## Resolution / dependency update

Core PR and reviewed exact commit, test evidence, published wheel digest,
research dependency-pin update and research-side reproduction check.

Check existing Issues/PRs before filing. A request does not authorize a core
patch from the research repository, a new economic experiment, unused-data
access, or order execution.
